map.由半衰期求衰变常数 使用指南: Decay Constant from Half-Life User Guide
map.由半衰期求衰变常数工具依据 λ=ln2/t½ 将半衰期换算为衰变常数，输入半衰期: The decay constant calculator tool converts a half-life into a decay constant with λ=ln2/t½, taking the half-life in seconds and returning λ — suited to parameter conversion in nuclear decay models.
map.输入半衰期 t½（秒），求衰变常数。: Enter half-life t½ (seconds) to get the decay constant.
map.λ = ln2/th 由半衰期反推衰变常数。: λ = ln2/th backs out the decay constant from the half-life.
map.：若 th=1 天≈8.64e4s，则 λ≈8.02×10⁻⁶ s⁻¹，寿命越短: : if th=1 day ≈ 8.64e4s, then λ≈8.02×10⁻⁶ s⁻¹ — the shorter the half-life the larger λ.
map.由衰变常数与时间求已衰变份额: Decayed fraction from decay constant and time
map.由吸收剂量与品质因数求剂量当量: Dose equivalent from absorbed dose and quality factor
map.由物理与生物半衰期求有效半衰期: Effective half-life from physical and biological half-lives
map.核裂变总能产额计算器: Nuclear fission total energy yield calculator
map.λ 与 th 成反比？: Is λ inversely proportional to th?
map.是，λ=ln2/th，半衰期越长衰变越慢、λ 越小。: Yes, λ=ln2/th — the longer the half-life the slower the decay and the smaller λ.
map.λ 单位为 s⁻¹（或 yr⁻¹，取决于 th 单位），表示单位时间衰变概率。: λ has units of s⁻¹ (or yr⁻¹, depending on the unit of th) and represents the decay probability per unit time.
